scenes.heading: HTTP
scenes.caption: HTTP is the language a client and a server use to exchange a request and a response on the web. The request names a method and a path. The response names a status and a body. Every page load and almost every app call is HTTP. If you can read a request, you can debug half of web work.

items: HTTP is the language a client and a server use to exchange a request and a response on the web

The response names a status and a body

scenes.heading: Step by step: HTTP
scenes.caption: The client sends a method, a path, headers, and sometimes a body. The server sends a status code, headers, and a body. 200 means success. 400 means the client asked badly. 500 means the server failed. The connection can succeed and the status can still say the operation failed.
